title: POLLED_DATA bus event envelope (MTap -> MBin)
description: Frozen v1 contract for the POLLED_DATA event. See POLLED_DATA.contract.md. `data` is an opaque passthrough of the upstream E*TRADE response and is intentionally left unconstrained.

data.description: Opaque passthrough of the raw upstream E*TRADE response; not reshaped by MTap.

_key.description: Idempotency key added by the Bus (present when published with an idempotencyKey).

_ts.description: Publish timestamp, ms since epoch, added by the Bus.

csvPrefix.description: Prefix for MBin's per-watchlist CSV naming.
